notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
Hey guys,

— February Patch —

Features:

Reintegrated multiple types of NPC’s including the boar, pig, cow, rabbits, foxes, dogs, cats and more with no known issues!

Added “Creative mode” which is a work in progress, single player only mode. This mode allows players to craft items instantly without any timer, or cost of materials. 

Added the ability to paint structures using a new item called "Paintbrush" which allows you to select through a large list of colors to paint your structures. Simply look at the structure, and press the quick slot key that the paintbrush is in to get the menu.

Added “Take all” button to storage inventories.

Added “Eat” option when right clicking on raw meat or cooked meat. 

Animals now instantly die when they are underwater.


All language packs can be accessed by the main menu on the bottom right there will be a language code for your language. ru is Russian, pl-PL is Polish.

Language Packs added:

Russian

Polish

 

Bug Fixes:

Fixed problem where the Hatchet item would be spawned in every time we login, now we only get a new hatchet if we don’t already have a hatchet. 

Fixed bug which stopped players from picking up items after they dropped them.

Fixed bug which allowed players to duplicate equipped items

Fixed bug which allowed players to duplicate axes

Fixed a bug where items which were equipped would become unequipped and added to your inventory upon second login. Now, items will remain equipped upon login and logout.

Fixed a bug which stopped the message telling the player they are over encumbered from appearing. 

Fixed a bug where players would fall through the world in single player mode.

Fixed a bug which caused foundations to be partially submerged underneath terrain.

If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to let me know.

Also I wanted to remind everyone that I have a patreon which can be accessed here:
[url]https://www.patreon.com/veritexstudios[/url]

We have gotten our very first Patron on Patreon this month which is fantastic! Huge thanks and shoutout to Florian for being our very first patron. 

Veritex Wiki:
[url]https://veritex.gamepedia.com/Veritex_Wiki[/url]

Thanks,
Bdoom

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
January Update!

The January update is pretty huge, I'm not going to lie. In the January update, we have added the ability for players to easily host their own servers for friends and family. All you have to do is click the "Host Game" button. Once you press this button, you are loaded into the map, and other players can join. No network configuration, no port forwarding, nothing. However, these servers are dependent on the person who created them. If the owner logs out, then the server goes down!

Second, we have also made the keybindings more obvious. Forward, and backwards are now properly labeled. Before this update, every keybind for forward, and backward movement was labeled as "Move Forward." 

Voice chat has been implemented, but still needs to go through further testing. Any feedback from players would be greatly appreciated.

If you have any other suggestions for changes, feel free to let us know on the steam forums. 

You can also check out our official Wiki here:
https://veritex.gamepedia.com/Veritex_Wiki

We also have a patreon where you can support us https://www.patreon.com/veritexstudios

Thanks,
Bdoom

notes.title: Veritex - Version 5 Patch notes
notes.content:
[h1]Issues fixed in version 5[/h1]

[list]
[*]All stats should be listed
[*]You cannot move
[*]Blurry Screen when taking damage with inventory open
[*]New button to light, and put out fires in campfires and furnaces.
[*]Change Smelting Timer from 30 Seconds to 15 Seconds
[*]Dropped Item Widget Should not show up miles away
[*]Fade from White when spawning / respawning
[*]CampFires, and Storage Boxes turn into "Bags" when out of range/loaded in slowly because their health = 0. Should do a Server check to make sure the server value is also zero.
[*]See if we can implement a more robust building system, similiar to Fortnite perhaps?
[*]Cannot damage structures with fists?
[*]Snow Biome has no food or water
[*]HotKey: Drop all Inventory Items to Bag.
[*]Make Health and other icons A LOT smaller. Should not take up more than a small corner of the screen
[*]Dropping an equipped item while it is equipped doesn't destroy / unequip the item.
[*]Add List of All Controls to Controls Menu
[*]Max Walk Angle Decreased from 65 degrees to 44.76 degrees.
[*]Re-implement Animals into the Game
[*]Work on User Tutorial
[*]Rivers
[*]Land Caves
[/list]

notes.title: 4/29/2018 Update Log
notes.content:
Fixes Since Last Build:
Map loading is much quicker.
Player Name Plates no longer always say “INVALID”
Players should no longer be able to spawn in other players beds
Players should no longer be able to destroy or repair other users bases. 
Crafting Should always work now
Weight and other inventory bugs and issues should all be fixed.
Users are no longer able to move using "F" move forward automatically functionality, and bypass weight movement limitations. 


New Features:
Bed Icons which show you where your beds are located
Screen Resolution can now be changed
Reorganized UI to be more clean
Added “Medium Storage Chest” which holds more item slots

All future updates are going to be additional features being implemented since the majority of bugs and other issues have been resolved. Look forward to more fun features being implemented soon.

notes.title: 4/20/2018 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Pretty big update today. Here is all the issues that have been fixed!

https://github.com/Bdoom/Veritex/issues/65

Not to mention that we now have a working single player mode, and all actions should work in first and third person now.


If these fixes are working, and valid. We will be reintroducing the animals and mobs back into the game. Once this has been done, we can finally attempt to start adding more FUN features such as caves, and improvements to the world itself.


Good luck everyone, and happy surviving. 

The 4/20/2018 update should be out in a few hours.

Thanks,
~Bdoom
